notes.title: Update! Patch notes: Your Seeds Are Safe Now
notes.content:
Patch Notes - Update Ver. 0.0469 (Don't ask)

Thanks a lot for all your feedback and reports! it really helps us make the game better!


Bug Fixes:

Fixed a bug where the resource colors would reset after closing and reopening the game.

Fixed a bug where prices were incorrectly calculated when purchasing 10 or 50 items at once.

Fixed an issue where house objects wouldn't appear until the house tab was clicked.

Fixed a bug that caused special mushrooms and flowers to spawn increasingly more frequently over time.

Quality of Life Improvements:

Added seed cost display to the tooltip when hovering over house upgrade buttons.

Added the seed value earned per click to the UI.



If you like what we're doing or you are curious about our future, slap that wishlist button, it helps more than you think. Thanks for all the love!
